_comment: Novamagus, the party's home base. Map legend: . cobblestones (walkable), v vegetation (blocks the way), @ where the party stands on arrival, i inn, s shop, t temple, d dungeon entrance. Walk into a building to enter it. Every row must be the same length. 'inn.price' is the cost of a night's rest (full HP/SP for the living). 'temple.price' revives one fallen hero. 'shop.stock' lists item ids from items.json, in the order shown; 'shop.sell_rate' is the fraction of an item's value paid when the party sells (0.5 = half). Edit freely and refresh!
name: Novamagus

inn.welcome: The innkeep stokes the fire. 'A warm bed and a hot meal — ten gold for the lot of you.'

temple.welcome: Candles gutter before the altar. 'The Light can call back the fallen... for an offering.'

shop.welcome: The shopkeep looks up from her ledger. 'Buying or selling? Coin either way.'
shop._comment: Economy pass (designer philosophy 2026-08-31): the store SCALES WITH THE PARTY'S ACHIEVEMENTS and complements adventuring — it never outruns the dungeon. A stock entry may be {'id', 'at_depth': N}: it appears only once the party has REACHED dungeon depth N this run (game.deepest; plain string = always stocked). Locked rows show greyed with the depth needed — aspiration, not absence. Bands (all proposals): start = survival basics + simple arms; depth 2 = the full basic arsenal + light/ring armor; depth 5 = heavy steel (scale/chain/tower, big two-handers); depth 7 = the Mastersmith's work + plate. ARCANE SPELL SCROLLS ARE GONE FROM THE SHELF (designer ruling: a new spell is a prize from adventuring, never a transaction — scrolls still DROP per dungeon.json scroll_drops). The one scroll sold is Cure Light Wounds — a divine prayer-scroll, cheaper than a Health Potion, readable only by a divine caster: the cleric's edge. DESPERATION SHELF (2026-08-31): exactly two Enchanted pieces at depth 8 — enchanted_staff (400g) and enchanted_longsword (800g) — so a party with no +1 drop is never locked out of magic_to_hit foes; keep the selection tiny, the price steep.
